name: Meera
text:
I like it when my days are dull. Like today.
A simple meal. My boring friends. That sweet itch of worthlessness.

name: Meera
text:
Today has been the worst kind of best.
I can hardly remember how it went.

name: Meera
text:
But day is done, gone the sun.
Tme to let one rip in the sheets, and turn a new page on my diary.
